# Prior Art Report Template

Write to `~/.cursor/prior-art/<slug>.md` unless user requests workspace path.

```markdown
# Prior Art: <human-readable title>

<!-- generated by @mine-stars on YYYY-MM-DD -->

## Intent

<problem / idea from chat>

## Capabilities sought

- …
- …

## Search scope

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| GitHub account | `<login via gh>` |
| Stars scanned | N |
| Cache | fresh \| refreshed |
| Local roots | … |

## Top matches

### 1. owner/repo — Score: NN — **inspirieren**

- **URL:** https://github.com/owner/repo
- **Domain:** DevTools \| Games \| ML \| …
- **Lateral:** yes \| no
- **Why relevant:** …
- **Evidence:** README quote or `path/to/file` — …
- **License:** MIT
- **Integration note:** …

### 2. …

## Lateral hits (cross-domain)

### owner/repo — …

## Classified summary

| Repo | übernehmen | inspirieren | Referenz | ignorieren |
|------|:----------:|:-----------:|:--------:|:----------:|
| owner/repo | | ✓ | | |

## No strong match

<!-- omit section if matches exist -->

Searched N stars; nothing scored ≥25 for this intent. Consider web search or broader GitHub code search outside stars.

## Suggested next steps

- Read: …
- Compare: …
- Optional: clone locally for deeper review
```

## Slug rules

- kebab-case from intent
- max 48 chars
- examples: `agent-mcp-orchestration`, `workflow-engine`, `dead-code-analysis`
